panels.title: Actual open positions (5m view, Mark, exchange TP/SL; check as-of)
panels.description: Only acknowledged generation ${projection}. Empty table is NOT proof of no positions unless row-count panel is complete and fresh. Account scope table; attribution column identifies bot. Ingestion is publication time; business times are columns. Fixed latest-view, not historical SQL.
